housing.summary: Numbeo's 1 September 2026 user-contributed estimate is USD 3,344.71 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/San-Diego?displayCurrency=USD . For most California residential rentals, the security-deposit cap is one month's rent: https://oag.ca.gov/tenants . Zillow is a San Diego rental-search portal: https://www.zillow.com/san-diego-ca/apartments/

banking.summary: Bank of America's official newcomer page requires a foreign address, proof of a U.S. physical address, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN/ITIN is needed only if already issued: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account
required_docs: proof of foreign home or permanent-residence address
one primary photo ID, such as a foreign passport
one secondary ID, such as a foreign driver's licence or qualifying payment card
foreign tax identification number; U.S. TIN/ITIN only if already issued

schools.summary: San Diego High School documents an International Baccalaureate curriculum and Diploma Programme: https://sdhs.sandiegounified.org/academics/international_baccalaureate_program . The San Diego County Office of Education School Finder is the regional directory for districts, public and charter schools, and educational programs: https://www.sdcoe.net/schools/finder

legal_admin.summary: No San Diego municipal residence-registration step was found. At the federal level, noncitizens in the United States generally must report each address change to USCIS within 10 days, except A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors; USCIS recommends its online account and also accepts Form AR-11 by mail: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange
legal_admin.registration_step: Report a change of U.S. address to USCIS within 10 days through a USCIS online account or Form AR-11, unless an exemption applies; there is no identified San Diego city residence registration.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a U.S. federal taxpayer ID and is ineligible for a Social Security number applies to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number with Form W-7; the IRS says not to file W-7 while eligible for or awaiting an SSN, and generally requires an SSA denial letter when SSA finds the applicant ineligible: https://www.irs.gov/instructions/iw7
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Social Security number (SSN), or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) when ineligible for an SSN

transport.summary: San Diego Metropolitan Transit System (MTS) operates MTS Bus, Trolley and Rapid services; the Regional Adult Month Pass is USD 72: https://www.sdmts.com/fares/fare-chart . California DMV says visitors 18+ may drive on a valid home-country licence, but California residents must obtain a California licence within 10 days and complete the DMV application/testing process: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/file/fast-facts-5-requirements-for-a-california-drivers-license/ . Eligible newcomers can apply for California's public Medi-Cal coverage through Covered California, or through a county office, by phone or by mail: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal-resources/medi-cal-eligibility-division/apply-for-medi-cal-or-other-affordable-quality-health-coverage/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Visitors age 18 or older may drive with a valid home-country licence; after becoming a California resident, obtain a California driver licence within 10 days and complete DMV application, identity/residency checks, knowledge and vision tests, plus a driving test if required.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible, apply for Medi-Cal through Covered California; applications are also accepted through a local county office, by phone, or by mail.
